website_summary.name: Hospital Management System (HMS)
website_summary.description: The website features a clean, peach-puff-themed interface with a sidebar for navigation and a dashboard displaying key hospital metrics.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a sidebar on the left with a navigation menu that includes options like Home, Finances, Reports, Pharmacy, Patient Files, Claim Formulation, Laboratory, and Theatre. The sidebar is styled with an Indian red background and white text. The main content area on the right displays a dashboard with three white cards showing Patient Overview, Financial Overview, and Inventory Overview. Each card contains relevant data points such as total patients, income, expenses, and inventory levels. The background of the main content area is peach puff, creating a visually appealing contrast with the sidebar.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to navigate through various sections for managing hospital operations. Users can access financial management features to handle patient fees and hospital finances. The reporting section enables the generation of inventory, patient, and financial reports. Employees can submit daily reports with detailed activity information. Pharmacy management includes inventory tracking of medicines. Patient files store information like patient names, visit dates, diagnoses, and comments. Additional functionalities include claim formulation, laboratory management, and theater management.
